label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter flows through switch-case logic into bar variable which is then passed to Utils.encodeForHTML() and concatenated directly into HTML output via PrintWriter.println(). The CodeQL report correctly identifies this as an XSS risk because untrusted input reaches an unsanitized HTML context.

evidence.note: User parameter extracted from request and assigned to bar based on switch condition
Unsafe concatenation of encoded bar into HTML string for printing
